---
title: "Expression functions"
toc-depth: 3
---

Functions in `Phibble\Expr` that build expressions for `filter()`, `mutate()`, `arrange()`, and `summarise()`, and the methods of Expr objects.

## Columns and literals

### `col()` {#col}

```php
col(string $name): Col
```

Reference to the column with the given name.

A plain PHP string passed to a helper is a literal; `col()` is how an expression reads a column.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$name` | <code>string</code> |  | The column name. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Col`\
**Examples** [phibble for Laravel developers](../laravel.qmd), [phibble](../index.qmd)

### `lit()` {#lit}

```php
lit(mixed $value): Lit
```

Literal value as an expression.

A date or datetime literal is typed as a date when its time of day is midnight, and as a datetime otherwise.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$value` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Null, a bool, int, float, or string, a DateTimeInterface, a `Phibble\Time`, or a list of scalars. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Lit`\
**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`: when the value is of another type, or a list holds a value that is not a scalar.

### `call()` {#call}

```php
call(string $fn, mixed ...$args): Call
```

Call to any registered function by name, such as call('str_sub', `col('s')`, 1, 3).

String keys in `$args` become named options; other arguments are positional. Values that are not expressions are wrapped as literals.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$fn` | <code>string</code> |  | The registered function name, as listed in Functions::REGISTRY. |
| `...$args` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Positional arguments, then named options. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`: when the function is not registered, the number of positional arguments is out of range, or a named option is not allowed.

### `desc()` {#desc}

```php
desc(Expr|string $expr): Desc
```

Descending sort key for `arrange()`, the first argument of a ranking function, or order_by.

`desc()` is rejected anywhere else in an expression.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$expr` | <code>Expr&#124;string</code> |  | An expression, or a column name. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Desc`

## Operators

### `Expr->add()` {#expr-add}

```php
$expr->add(mixed $other): Call
```

Sum of this expression and `$other`.

NA gives NA. Adding a period such as `days(1)` to a date or datetime uses clock arithmetic, and adding seconds or a time to a time gives a time.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$other` | <code>mixed</code> |  | An expression or literal. |

**Method** of `Phibble\Expr\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Examples** [Expressions](../expr.qmd), [Types](../types.qmd)

### `Expr->sub()` {#expr-sub}

```php
$expr->sub(mixed $other): Call
```

Difference of this expression and `$other`.

NA gives NA. Subtracting a date from a date gives days, a datetime from a datetime gives seconds, and a period from a date or datetime uses clock arithmetic.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$other` | <code>mixed</code> |  | An expression or literal. |

**Method** of `Phibble\Expr\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Examples** [Expressions](../expr.qmd), [Getting started](../getting-started.qmd)

### `Expr->mul()` {#expr-mul}

```php
$expr->mul(mixed $other): Call
```

Product of this expression and `$other`.

NA gives NA. A period or time multiplied by a number is scaled.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$other` | <code>mixed</code> |  | An expression or literal. |

**Method** of `Phibble\Expr\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Examples** [Getting started](../getting-started.qmd), [SQL tables](../sql.qmd)

### `Expr->div()` {#expr-div}

```php
$expr->div(mixed $other): Call
```

Quotient of this expression and `$other`, always a float.

NA gives NA. Division by zero gives Inf or -Inf, and 0 / 0 gives NaN, as in R.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$other` | <code>mixed</code> |  | An expression or literal. |

**Method** of `Phibble\Expr\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Examples** [Expressions](../expr.qmd), [SQL tables](../sql.qmd), [Getting started](../getting-started.qmd)

### `Expr->mod()` {#expr-mod}

```php
$expr->mod(mixed $other): Call
```

Remainder of this expression divided by `$other`, with the sign of `$other`.

R's %% operator: the remainder after floored division. NA gives NA. An integer remainder by zero is NA, and a float remainder by zero NaN.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$other` | <code>mixed</code> |  | An expression or literal. |

**Method** of `Phibble\Expr\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Examples** [Expressions](../expr.qmd)

### `Expr->pow()` {#expr-pow}

```php
$expr->pow(mixed $other): Call
```

This expression raised to the power `$other`, as a float.

R's ^ operator. NA gives NA.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$other` | <code>mixed</code> |  | An expression or literal. |

**Method** of `Phibble\Expr\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `Expr->neg()` {#expr-neg}

```php
$expr->neg(): Call
```

Negation of this expression.

NA gives NA.

**Method** of `Phibble\Expr\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `Expr->eq()` {#expr-eq}

```php
$expr->eq(mixed $other): Call
```

Whether this expression equals `$other`.

R's == operator. NA on either side gives NA. Numbers and logicals compare numerically, dates and datetimes by instant, and other values as strings.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$other` | <code>mixed</code> |  | An expression or literal. |

**Method** of `Phibble\Expr\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Examples** [phibble for Laravel developers](../laravel.qmd), [SQL tables](../sql.qmd)

### `Expr->ne()` {#expr-ne}

```php
$expr->ne(mixed $other): Call
```

Whether this expression differs from `$other`.

R's != operator. NA on either side gives NA. Numbers and logicals compare numerically, dates and datetimes by instant, and other values as strings.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$other` | <code>mixed</code> |  | An expression or literal. |

**Method** of `Phibble\Expr\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Examples** [Getting started](../getting-started.qmd)

### `Expr->lt()` {#expr-lt}

```php
$expr->lt(mixed $other): Call
```

Whether this expression is less than `$other`.

R's < operator. NA on either side gives NA. Numbers and logicals compare numerically, dates and datetimes by instant, and other values as strings, byte by byte.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$other` | <code>mixed</code> |  | An expression or literal. |

**Method** of `Phibble\Expr\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `Expr->le()` {#expr-le}

```php
$expr->le(mixed $other): Call
```

Whether this expression is less than or equal to `$other`.

R's <= operator. NA on either side gives NA. Numbers and logicals compare numerically, dates and datetimes by instant, and other values as strings, byte by byte.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$other` | <code>mixed</code> |  | An expression or literal. |

**Method** of `Phibble\Expr\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Examples** [Expressions](../expr.qmd)

### `Expr->gt()` {#expr-gt}

```php
$expr->gt(mixed $other): Call
```

Whether this expression is greater than `$other`.

R's > operator. NA on either side gives NA. Numbers and logicals compare numerically, dates and datetimes by instant, and other values as strings, byte by byte.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$other` | <code>mixed</code> |  | An expression or literal. |

**Method** of `Phibble\Expr\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Examples** [Expressions](../expr.qmd), [Types](../types.qmd), [Getting started](../getting-started.qmd)

### `Expr->ge()` {#expr-ge}

```php
$expr->ge(mixed $other): Call
```

Whether this expression is greater than or equal to `$other`.

R's >= operator. NA on either side gives NA. Numbers and logicals compare numerically, dates and datetimes by instant, and other values as strings, byte by byte.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$other` | <code>mixed</code> |  | An expression or literal. |

**Method** of `Phibble\Expr\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Examples** [Expressions](../expr.qmd)

### `Expr->and()` {#expr-and}

```php
$expr->and(mixed $other): Call
```

Logical AND of this expression and `$other`.

R's & operator, with three-valued logic: false wins over NA, and NA with true gives NA.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$other` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A logical expression or literal. |

**Method** of `Phibble\Expr\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Examples** [Expressions](../expr.qmd)

### `Expr->or()` {#expr-or}

```php
$expr->or(mixed $other): Call
```

Logical OR of this expression and `$other`.

R's \| operator, with three-valued logic: true wins over NA, and NA with false gives NA.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$other` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A logical expression or literal. |

**Method** of `Phibble\Expr\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Examples** [Expressions](../expr.qmd)

### `Expr->not()` {#expr-not}

```php
$expr->not(): Call
```

Logical negation of this expression.

R's ! operator. NA gives NA.

**Method** of `Phibble\Expr\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Examples** [Expressions](../expr.qmd), [phibble](../index.qmd)

### `Expr->isNa()` {#expr-isna}

```php
$expr->isNa(): Call
```

Whether each value is NA.

NaN counts as NA. Equivalent to `is_na()`.

**Method** of `Phibble\Expr\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Examples** [phibble](../index.qmd)

### `Expr->isIn()` {#expr-isin}

```php
$expr->isIn(array $values): Call
```

Whether each value is one of the given values.

R's %in% operator. Dates, datetimes, and times compare by value. NA matches only when the list holds null. The result is never NA.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$values` | <code>list&lt;mixed&gt;</code> |  | The values to match: null, scalars, or dates, datetimes, or times of one kind. |

**Method** of `Phibble\Expr\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`: when a value is another type, or the list mixes scalars with temporal values or times with dates.\
**Examples** [Expressions](../expr.qmd), [SQL tables](../sql.qmd)

### `Expr->between()` {#expr-between}

```php
$expr->between(mixed $low, mixed $high): Call
```

Whether each value lies between `$low` and `$high`, inclusive.

NA in the value or either bound gives NA. Equivalent to `between()`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$low` | <code>mixed</code> |  | The lower bound. |
| `$high` | <code>mixed</code> |  | The upper bound. |

**Method** of `Phibble\Expr\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `Expr->desc()` {#expr-desc}

```php
$expr->desc(): Desc
```

Descending sort key on this expression, for `arrange()`, the first argument of a ranking function, or order_by.

Equivalent to `desc()`.

**Method** of `Phibble\Expr\Expr`\
**Returns** `Desc`

## Conditionals and missing values

### `is_na()` {#is-na}

```php
is_na(mixed $x): Call
```

Whether each value is NA.

NaN counts as NA.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A column expression, such as `col('x')`, or a literal. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `if_else()` {#if-else}

```php
if_else(
    mixed $condition,
    mixed $true,
    mixed $false,
    mixed ...$options,
): Call
```

Value of `$true` where the condition holds and of `$false` where it does not.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$condition` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A logical expression. |
| `$true` | <code>mixed</code> |  | The value where the condition is true. |
| `$false` | <code>mixed</code> |  | The value where the condition is false. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: missing (mixed, default NA) is the value where the condition is NA. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `case_when()` {#case-when}

```php
case_when(mixed ...$args): Call
```

Value paired with the first condition that holds, as `case_when(cond1, value1, cond2, value2, ..., default: value)`.

Conditions are tested in order per row; an NA condition does not match.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `...$args` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Condition and value pairs, then named options: default (mixed, default NA) is the value where no condition holds. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`: when the positional arguments do not form condition and value pairs.

### `coalesce()` {#coalesce}

```php
coalesce(mixed ...$args): Call
```

First value that is not NA among the arguments, row by row.

NaN counts as NA and is skipped, as in `is_na()` and R's `coalesce()`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `...$args` | <code>mixed</code> |  | One or more expressions or literals. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `between()` {#between}

```php
between(mixed $x, mixed $low, mixed $high): Call
```

Whether each value lies between `$low` and `$high`, inclusive.

The result is NA where `$x`, `$low`, or `$high` is NA.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A column expression, such as `col('x')`, or a literal. |
| `$low` | <code>mixed</code> |  | The lower bound. |
| `$high` | <code>mixed</code> |  | The upper bound. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `na_if()` {#na-if}

```php
na_if(mixed $x, mixed $y): Call
```

Values of `$x`, with NA where `$x` equals `$y`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A column expression, such as `col('x')`, or a literal. |
| `$y` | <code>mixed</code> |  | The value to replace with NA. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `near()` {#near}

```php
near(mixed $x, mixed $y, mixed ...$options): Call
```

Whether `$x` and `$y` are equal within a tolerance.

The result is NA where either value is NA.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A numeric expression or literal. |
| `$y` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A numeric expression or literal. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: tol (float, default `sqrt(PHP_FLOAT_EPSILON)`, about 1.5e-8) is the tolerance; an absolute difference below it counts as equal. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`


**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `round()` {#round}

```php
round(mixed $x, mixed ...$options): Call
```

Value rounded to a number of decimal digits.

Rounding follows R 4.0 and later: the candidate nearer the stored double wins, and exact ties go to the even digit, so `round(2.675, digits: 2)` is 2.67. Integers are returned unchanged when digits is 0 or more. SQL backends evaluate it in memory.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A numeric expression or literal. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: digits (int, default 0) is the number of decimal places; a negative value rounds to tens, hundreds, and so on. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `floor()` {#floor}

```php
floor(mixed $x): Call
```

Largest whole number not greater than the value, as a float.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A numeric expression or literal. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `ceiling()` {#ceiling}

```php
ceiling(mixed $x): Call
```

Smallest whole number not less than the value, as a float.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A numeric expression or literal. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

## Aggregates

### `n()` {#n}

```php
n(): Call
```

Number of rows in the group.

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Examples** [phibble for Laravel developers](../laravel.qmd), [phibble](../index.qmd)

### `sum()` {#sum}

```php
sum(mixed $x, mixed ...$options): Call
```

Sum of the values.

The result is NA when a value is NA, unless na_rm is true. The sum is an integer when every value is an integer or logical, and 0 for no values. The sum of times is a time.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A numeric expression. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: na_rm (bool, default false) drops NA first. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`: at evaluation, when the values are dates or datetimes.

### `mean()` {#mean}

```php
mean(mixed $x, mixed ...$options): Call
```

Mean of the values.

The result is NA when a value is NA, unless na_rm is true, and NaN for no values. The mean of dates is a date, of datetimes a datetime, and of times a time.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A numeric or temporal expression. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: na_rm (bool, default false) drops NA first. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Examples** [phibble for Laravel developers](../laravel.qmd), [phibble](../index.qmd)

### `median()` {#median}

```php
median(mixed $x, mixed ...$options): Call
```

Median of the values.

The result is NA when a value is NA, unless na_rm is true, and NA for no values. The median of dates is a date, of datetimes a datetime, and of times a time.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A numeric or temporal expression. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: na_rm (bool, default false) drops NA first. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Examples** [phibble](../index.qmd)

### `min()` {#min}

```php
min(mixed $x, mixed ...$options): Call
```

Smallest of the values.

The result is NA when a value is NA, unless na_rm is true, NaN when a value is NaN, and Inf for no values. Strings compare byte by byte.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A column expression, such as `col('x')`, or a literal. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: na_rm (bool, default false) drops NA first. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `max()` {#max}

```php
max(mixed $x, mixed ...$options): Call
```

Largest of the values.

The result is NA when a value is NA, unless na_rm is true, NaN when a value is NaN, and -Inf for no values. Strings compare byte by byte.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A column expression, such as `col('x')`, or a literal. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: na_rm (bool, default false) drops NA first. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Examples** [phibble for Laravel developers](../laravel.qmd)

### `sd()` {#sd}

```php
sd(mixed $x, mixed ...$options): Call
```

Sample standard deviation of the values.

The divisor is n - 1, and the result is NA for fewer than two values. The result is NA when a value is NA, unless na_rm is true. Dates are measured in days, and datetimes and times in seconds.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A numeric or temporal expression. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: na_rm (bool, default false) drops NA first. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `var_()` {#var-}

```php
var_(mixed $x, mixed ...$options): Call
```

Sample variance of the values.

R's `var()`; the trailing underscore avoids PHP's reserved word. The divisor is n - 1, and the result is NA for fewer than two values. The result is NA when a value is NA, unless na_rm is true. Dates are measured in days, and datetimes and times in seconds.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A numeric or temporal expression. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: na_rm (bool, default false) drops NA first. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `quantile()` {#quantile}

```php
quantile(mixed $x, mixed $p, mixed ...$options): Call
```

Sample quantile of the values at probability `$p`.

Uses R's default method (type 7), interpolating between order statistics. The quantile of datetimes is a datetime, and of times a time.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A numeric or temporal expression. |
| `$p` | <code>mixed</code> |  | The probability, from 0 to 1. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: na_rm (bool, default false) drops NA first. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`: at evaluation, when a value is NA and na_rm is false, or when the values are dates.

### `iqr()` {#iqr}

```php
iqr(mixed $x, mixed ...$options): Call
```

Interquartile range of the values: the 0.75 quantile minus the 0.25 quantile.

R's IQR(). Quantiles use R's default method (type 7). The result is NA for no values. Dates are measured in days, and datetimes and times in seconds.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A numeric or temporal expression. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: na_rm (bool, default false) drops NA first. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`: at evaluation, when a value is NA and na_rm is false.

### `n_distinct()` {#n-distinct}

```php
n_distinct(mixed ...$args): Call
```

Number of distinct values, or of distinct combinations across several arguments.

NA counts as a distinct value unless na_rm is true.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `...$args` | <code>mixed</code> |  | One or more expressions, then named options: na_rm (bool, default false) skips rows where any argument is NA. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

## Window functions

### `lag()` {#lag}

```php
lag(mixed $x, mixed ...$options): Call
```

Value from n rows earlier in the group.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A column expression, such as `col('x')`, or a literal. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: n (int, default 1) is the offset; default (mixed, default NA) fills rows with no earlier row; order_by (expression, default row order) sets the order, NA last, and accepts `desc()`. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `lead()` {#lead}

```php
lead(mixed $x, mixed ...$options): Call
```

Value from n rows later in the group.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | A column expression, such as `col('x')`, or a literal. |
| `...$options` | <code>mixed</code> |  | Named options: n (int, default 1) is the offset; default (mixed, default NA) fills rows with no later row; order_by (expression, default row order) sets the order, NA last, and accepts `desc()`. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `row_number()` {#row-number}

```php
row_number(mixed $x = null): Call
```

Row number within the group, or the rank of each value with ties broken by row order.

With no argument, rows are numbered 1 to n in their order. With an argument, NA values get NA, and a factor column ranks by level order.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> | <code>null</code> | An expression to rank by, or `desc()` of one. Omit it to number rows in order. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Throws** `ArgumentCountError`: when given more than one argument.

### `min_rank()` {#min-rank}

```php
min_rank(mixed $x): Call
```

Rank of each value, ties sharing the lowest rank, with gaps after ties.

NA values get NA. A factor column ranks by level order.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | An expression to rank by, or `desc()` of one. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `dense_rank()` {#dense-rank}

```php
dense_rank(mixed $x): Call
```

Rank of each value, ties sharing a rank, with no gaps after ties.

NA values get NA. A factor column ranks by level order.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | An expression to rank by, or `desc()` of one. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `percent_rank()` {#percent-rank}

```php
percent_rank(mixed $x): Call
```

Minimum rank rescaled to the range 0 to 1: (min_rank - 1) / (m - 1), where m is the number of non-NA values.

NA values get NA. With one non-NA value, the result is NaN.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | An expression to rank by, or `desc()` of one. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `cume_dist()` {#cume-dist}

```php
cume_dist(mixed $x): Call
```

Cumulative distribution: the share of non-NA values less than or equal to each value.

NA values get NA.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> |  | An expression to rank by, or `desc()` of one. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`

### `ntile()` {#ntile}

```php
ntile(mixed $x = null, ?int $n = null): Call
```

Bucket number from 1 to n, splitting the ordered values into n groups as evenly as possible.

Earlier buckets take the extra rows when the sizes differ. NA values get NA. Without `$x`, rows are bucketed in row order.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | <code>mixed</code> | <code>null</code> | An expression to order by, or `desc()` of one. Null or omitted buckets rows in order. |
| `$n` | <code>int&#124;null</code> | <code>null</code> | The number of buckets. Required. |

**Function** in `Phibble\Expr`\
**Returns** `Call`\
**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`: when n is not given.\
**Throws** `ArgumentCountError`: when given more than two arguments.

Cumulative sum in row order.

Once a value is NA, every later result is NA.

## Expression objects

### `Expr::of()` {#expr-of}

```php
Expr::of(mixed $value): Expr
```

PHP value wrapped as a literal expression; an expression is returned unchanged.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$value` | <code>mixed</code> |  | An expression, or a value `lit()` accepts. |

**Static method** of `Phibble\Expr\Expr`\
**Returns** `Expr`\
**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`: when the value is not one `lit()` accepts.

### `Expr::fromArray()` {#expr-fromarray}

```php
Expr::fromArray(array $node): Expr
```

Expression rebuilt from the array form that `toArray()` returns.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$node` | <code>array&lt;string, mixed&gt;</code> |  | A node as `toArray()` gives it. |

**Static method** of `Phibble\Expr\Expr`\
**Returns** `Expr`\
**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`: when a node has an unknown type, a literal is invalid, or a call does not fit the function registry.\
**Examples** [Expressions](../expr.qmd)

### `Expr->toArray()` {#expr-toarray}

```php
$expr->toArray(): array
```

JSON-friendly description of the expression tree.

**Method** of `Phibble\Expr\Expr`\
**Returns** `array<string, mixed>`\

### `Expr->columns()` {#expr-columns}

Names of the columns the expression reads, in order of first use.
